description: Energiequellen Windkraftanlagen Land Bremen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.bremen.de. This presentation service (WMS) provides content on the wind turbines of the state of Bremen in the INSPIRE data model for the INSPIRE topic of energy sources. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WMS Energy Sources Wind Turbines Land Bremen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Freie Hansestadt Bremen, Windkraftanlagen, inspireidentifiziert, Windkraftanlagenstandorte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
